gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-92.668612 41.30199)',4326)::geography, 2700)
    AND p.tourism = 'viewpoint'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 140;

WITH center_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-92.668612 41.30199)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
viewpoints AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%viewpoint%' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geom::geometry FROM center_point), 2700)
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM viewpoints), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM viewpoints))
),
elevation_filtered_viewpoints AS (
  SELECT v.id
  FROM viewpoints v
  JOIN clipped_dem d ON ST_Intersects(v.geometry::geometry, d.rast)
  WHERE ST_Value(d.rast, v.geometry::geometry) <= 140
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_viewpoints
FROM elevation_filtered_viewpoints;
